numerical_gate.contract: The full original activation vector uses one dynamic maxabs/127 A8 scale before any full-C dot.
numerical_gate.consequence: Same ready chunk can require different A8 bytes after the unseen tail arrives. Block quantization/static scale is a numerical-format change. Native output summation support alone does not remove this input-scale dependency.
numerical_gate.qualification: This is a reference-format barrier, not a claim that all possible AiF input formats have a global quantizer. It also does not establish numerical equivalence to the original NVFP4 routing checkpoint.

sources.title: AiF: Accelerating On-Device LLM Inference Using In-Flash Processing
sources.read_depth: Local supplied full paper sections4.3/4.4/5.2; current publisher-indexed primary text corroborates.
sources.finding: IFP weights occupy be-enc LSB pages. Native command supplies input dimension, block, offset and page count, then loads input PBs. Results enter FIFO. CSB/MSB compute, arbitrary initial plane masks, retained-input command and output/scale ABI are not established.

sources.read_depth: Reuse prior primary fulltext abstract/sections1-3 incl states/definitions; current primary repository search excerpt rechecked.
sources.finding: Joint item replication and owner assignment under a capacity budget, optimized using query logs. Same native-job inventory and owner choices are a mandatory exact control, not a weaker token-count approximation.

sources.title: Linear-Programming-Based Load Balancer (official DeepSeek LPLB)
sources.read_depth: Fetched full pinned official README; no GPU binary executed.
sources.finding: Static replica topology plus perbatch LP rerouting is prior. Official limitations include token-count cost approximation and roughly100us intra-node planner overhead; this is not a calibrated estimate for our small CPU selector.

sources.title: MegaFlux: Skew-Resilient MoE Megakernels via Pipelined Expert Replication
sources.read_depth: Read primary sections2.1/3 and AppendixA; searched paper links/GitHub repositories; no paper-specific author artifact verified.
sources.finding: Runtime expert replication and tile-aligned token assignment preserve routing. Perprojection FC1/FC2 readiness overlaps replica transfer; GPU native block scaling/readiness is not an AiF input/output contract. Token blocks are not weight-row shards.

sources.title: PowerInfer-2: Fast Large Language Model Inference on a Smartphone
sources.read_depth: Read primary section4.4 and author website pipeline description.
sources.finding: Neuron-cluster pipelining explicitly breaks matrix barriers across gate/up/down I/O and computation. Porting that pattern is not a new mechanism; its sparse heterogeneous engine does not prove exact AiF A8 semantics.

sources.title: TileLens: Efficiently Using Large-Granularity Memory Systems with Transparent Two-Dimensional Memory Layout
sources.read_depth: Read primary sections3-5 and6.7; no paper-specific official artifact verified.
sources.finding: Tile-major page packing, tile-shape sensitivity and native memory-layout support directly threaten generic geometry-compiler novelty. SW uses CuTe/TMA descriptors; HW changes TMA/prefetch/MSHR support. Neither proves an available AiF capability. Same-name Triton visualization repositories are unrelated.

sources.title: FLINT: Efficiently Leveraging High Bandwidth Flash for Capacity-Scalable LLM Inference Acceleration
sources.read_depth: Read primary sections4.1-4.4 and refresh-architecture evidence; no artifact validated.
sources.finding: Burst coalescing uses an HBF base-die controller; refresh adds one physical plane and four hardware structures. Its N+1-plane remapping/refresh timings cannot be imported as existing AiF placement, and its in-place refresh result is not a measured AiF maintenance duty.

sources.title: PAHT: Process-Aware History Tracking for Fast Read Retry in High-Capacity 3D NAND SSDs
sources.read_depth: Primary indexed abstract only; direct HTML403 and browser429. No fulltext or public dataset acquired.
sources.finding: Current search found further NAND process/retry evidence but no same-be-enc-LSB latency data or new compute contract. Do not infer calibrated AiF variation from this abstract.

recommendation: Do not advertise2-3new mechanisms: evidence supports at most a small Q38 shared-replication portability screen. The next high-value work is native address/input/output/scale calibration and a general compiler characterization against same-backend Cambricon/HDA/tile-layout/RDA controls. A systems contribution remains possible; these bounds do not establish it or disprove it.
erratum: The difference between whole-view and RDA work-oracle values is not a strict bound on their achievable schedule difference. Only observed-incumbent minus each necessary bound limits absolute speedup under the fixed inventory.
